title: Two-pass capture: project-aware then project-blind
summary: Run a precision pass tuned to the project, then a separate recall pass that ignores the project entirely to catch off-topic sparks.
detail: Precision and recall pull in opposite directions inside one filter, so splitting into two passes lets each pass tune to its own goal instead of compromising.

title: Never let a similarity threshold auto-decide keep/drop
summary: Statistics should shortlist candidates; only the model should adjudicate whether two ideas are the same.
trigger: before wiring any embedding-similarity check into an automated keep/drop decision
